new_scholarship.name: International English Admission Scholarship
new_scholarship.deadline: No application - awarded automatically at the time of admission
new_scholarship.application_period: Available to students newly admitted for the Winter 2026 term or later. Awarded automatically on full-time enrolment; applicants are notified at the time of admission.
new_scholarship.application_method: Automatic - all eligible students are considered and notified at admission
new_scholarship.description: The University of Ottawa International English Admission Scholarship pays $7,500 per term, totalling $60,000 over a four-year degree, to newly admitted international students in approved English-language undergraduate programmes. The number of awards is unlimited, it is awarded automatically on full-time enrolment, and it reduces tuition fees immediately.
new_scholarship.best_fit: A newly admitted international student with an 80%+ admission average entering an English-language undergraduate programme in Arts, Engineering, Health Sciences, Science, Social Sciences or the Telfer School of Management, and paying international tuition fees.
new_scholarship.eligibility_summary: International students with a valid study permit, newly admitted for the Winter 2026 term or later to an approved English-language undergraduate programme, with a minimum admission average of 80%, not enrolling in the French immersion stream, and enrolled full-time. Canadian citizens with dual citizenship are not eligible.

programme_detail_official.description: The University of Ottawa offers newly admitted international students in English-language undergraduate programmes an automatic, unlimited, renewable scholarship of $7,500 per term worth $60,000 over four years, with a companion $10,000-per-term excellence award for applicants with a 90% or above average.
programme_detail_official.coverage: Tuition fees, reduced immediately; not living costs or travel

application_readiness_checklist: Apply to an eligible English-language undergraduate programme - Arts, Engineering, Health Sciences, Science, Social Sciences or Telfer
Secure a Canadian study permit, since eligibility depends on it
Achieve an admission average of 80% or above for the $7,500-per-term award, or 90%+ for the excellence award
Do not apply to the French immersion stream for this award
Apply through the official OUAC form and pay the required fees
Expect the award to appear automatically on your tuition once you enrol full-time - there is no scholarship form
common_rejection_risks: Enrolling in the French immersion stream, which is explicitly excluded
Paying domestic tuition fees, which makes the student ineligible
Having dual Canadian citizenship, which is explicitly excluded
Applying to a faculty or programme not on the approved English-language list
Missing the Winter 2026-or-later entry window by applying to an earlier term
estimated_uncovered_costs: Tuition above $7,500 per term, and anything beyond 12 instalments
Travel, immigration and permanent residence costs
document_audit: No scholarship documents - the award is automatic
Standard admission documents including proof of study permit eligibility
Any documents required by the Online Scholarships and Bursaries tool for separate awards such as mobility scholarships

alerts.message: Unlike most competitive awards, this one has no cap. Meeting the criteria secures it.
Tuition fees are immediately reduced by the scholarship amount, so there is no separate cheque or payment.
The award covers a maximum of 12 instalments, which corresponds to a four-year degree.
The International English Academic Excellence Scholarship is not renewable but can be combined with this award, so the published English-language total of up to $70,000 reflects stacking.
